meta.name: qwen3-tts-local
meta.description: 真正的本地语音合成服务，使用 Edge-TTS 引擎，零依赖、零配置、完全离线可用，支持多语言和多种音色

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用本地语音引擎将文字转为自然语音
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在本地离线生成多语言语音
copy.tagline_en: Convert text to natural speech using a local engine
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need offline multi-language speech generation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把文字转成语音。它支持中文、英语、日语、韩语等多种语言和 20 多种预设音色，自动分析文本并生成音频文件。
howto.when: 当用户直接要求朗读文本、生成配音，或指定语言/音色朗读时触发，无需任何配置。

say.text: 朗读这段文本，用温柔女声
say.note: 自动选用中文温柔女声音色

say.text: 用日语朗读这段话：こんにちは
用英语朗读这段话：Hello, how are you?

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can convert written text into speech. It supports multiple languages including Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, and offers 20+ preset voices. It automatically analyzes the text and generates an audio file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user directly requests text-to-speech, voiceover generation, or reading in a specified language/voice, without any setup. Examples: 'Read this text' or 'Generate an English voiceover'.

say_en.text: Read this text in a gentle female voice.
say_en.note: Auto-selects a Chinese gentle female voice.

say_en.text: Read this in Japanese: こんにちは
Read this in English: Hello, how are you?
